name: Art of War 2: Global Confederation
summary: Art of War 2: Global Confederation is a real-time strategy game and the sequel to Art of War: N.A.C. It is set in 2038, twenty years after the Earth was united under the rule of the Global Confederation. The century-long global territorial wars have subsided and the Confederation keeps only a small peacekeeping force, but a resistance movement opposed to the Senate's policies is gaining momentum all over the world. When signs of rebel activity appear in eastern Peru, until then the calmest of regions, the player takes the role of a Confederation general sent to crush the revolt and capture the leader of the rebellion across seven campaign missions.
